properties.name: Jebel Barkal
properties.description: Sacred mountain of Kush where Amun was believed to dwell. A natural rock pinnacle resembles the uraeus (royal cobra), confirming divine presence.

properties.name: Pyramids of Meroë
properties.description: Over 200 pyramids of the Kushite kings and queens, smaller but steeper than Egyptian ones. Each housed a burial chamber with rich grave goods.
